outcomes.error: Error: Failed to persist workflow: 400 Bad Request - {"code":400,"message":"Unable to process JSON"}

method: Persist a newly created, unexecuted synthetic workflow at two sizes, retrieve exact content after success, and delete the temporary workflow in finally.
